intent: Use verified, explicitly selected Home Assistant room temperature sensors in monitored-room climate and mold evidence, distinguish environment-only monitoring from individual native HVAC controllers, and add native Managed Climate popups, per-device control method selections and manual target editing to the Lovelace card.
note: Do not substitute unavailable pinned sensors, infer HVAC modes from temperature readings, invent physical capabilities or bypass PID/window/ownership/safety checks; preserve the canonical environment_manager domain and all beta31-33 fixes.
changes: Evaluate explicitly selected room temperature sensors (including multiple readings) using strict physical/area/staleness validation; preserve exact pinned source priority and never synthesize a measurement.
Use verified selected room temperature evidence for mold indicator input only when no fixed sensor is configured, and for room-level climate planning without authorizing extra hardware.
Expose room temperature evidence and source IDs in climate plan diagnostics rather than silently reporting no measurement.
Translate environment_only_no_hvac into understandable room-monitoring text; keep independent physical managed controllers separately visible.
Show each Manager-controlled native climate entity on the room card, opening Home Assistant's own More Info popup on click.

Expose the exact native managed controller's existing select.control_method options; when Manual is active show supported temperature/humidity setpoint inputs and issue standard select.select_option / climate.set_temperature / climate.set_humidity service calls only for matched device entities.
Fix legacy card pause/resume calls from old home_environment_manager alias to canonical environment_manager.
Replace raw metric_unknown on card with source identity; do not relabel unknown measurements as valid.
Add regression tests for selected sensor mean and pinned failure, card action/target validation, HA popup binding and cross-area safety.
Gate publication on Python 3.13/3.14, installed HA 2026.10, HACS/Hassfest, 38-language catalogs, frontend checks and flat-tag extraction.
